title: Supermarket Stakeout
description: Alex Guarnaschelli hosts as four chefs square off in a competitive pop-up kitchen outside a grocery store; assigned a theme for each round, the chefs must size up shoppers as they exit the store and negotiate their grocery bags.

title: Supermarket Stakeout
description: Alex Guarnaschelli challenges the four chefs to channel their competitiveness into cooking up a winning tailgate; the three who survive create dishes to celebrate, and the two final chefs have to impress the judges with a delicious dippable dish.

title: Supermarket Stakeout
description: The chefs stake out carts to create the perfect hangover helper, and only the well-seasoned survive when they dish up dishes from the bayou; one chef is toast when they can't bring the heat, and Alex joins judge Eric Adjepong to choose the winner.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Guy Fieri's digging into the unexpected; a South African spot in Black Mountain, N.C., is cooking lights-out lamb curry; a chef in San Jose, Calif., is bringing big flavor to beef barbacoa; a Boynton Beach, Fla., joint is serving up chicken oysters.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Savoring sammies, sausage, and sweets; a funky Filipino joint in Sacramento, Calif., is making cookies; also, a West Palm Beach, Fla., spot is smoking gator sausage; plus, an elevated eatery in Tampa, Fla., is plating an out-of-bounds Italian sandwich.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description: Danielle Sepsy teams up with her mom to make Pepperoni Stromboli with a flavorful filling and golden crust. Then, Danielle welcomes her grandma to the kitchen to make a Mile High Classic Top-Heavy Deli Crumb Cake with a thick layer of buttery crumbs.

title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
description: Danielle Sepsy shares two items from her bakery, The Hungry Gnome; she makes cherry vanilla bean scones, then bakes blueberry crumb muffins topped with a buttery streusel.

title: The Kitchen
description: Katie Lee Biegel whips up queso with garlic lime tortilla chips, Geoffrey Zakarian makes chicken fajitas and Alex Guarnaschelli prepares spinach and mushroom vegetable enchiladas.

description: Five fantastic cookie makers reveal what happens the day after Christmas at the North Pole; the competitors help Santa park his sleigh with decorated and durable cookie rooftops.

title: The Kitchen
description: The kitchen puts side dishes on center stage and Jeff Mauro shares his essential tips for stuffing; recipes include smoked Gouda skillet Mac and Cheese, herbed potato salad and twice baked miso sweet potatoes; Jeff has ways to use leftovers.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Chef Robert Irvine travels to Joshua, Texas, to save a failing Tex-Mex restaurant; owners Carmen and Wayne are serving sub-par food, the environment in the restaurant is toxic, and the couple's relationship is in dire straits too.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Chef Robert Irvine travels to San Diego to save German restaurant Kaiserhof, where the owner is afraid to make changes for fear of disturbing his late father's original design; Robert flexes serious muscle to drag the restaurant into the present.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Chef Robert Irvine heads to the Jalisco Cafe in San Diego and tackles one of the filthiest kitchens of his career; with endless obstacles and only 48 hours to turn this restaurant around, the challenge might actually be impossible.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: In Berkeley, Calif., 50-year legacy restaurant KC's BBQ is on the brink of closure; chef Robert Irvine must help the owner regain his self-confidence, treat his daughter like a true partner and accept change in order to save their family restaurant.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Chef Robert Irvine finds The Breakfast Place in San Jose, Calif., struggling to stay open; the co-owners are burnt out and don't have the confidence to lead their staff; Robert must try to save their friendship and business before it's too late.

title: Candified: Home for the Holidays
description: Jackie Sorkin, the Candy Queen, and her team of candy artists are challenged to build a life-size candy house in six weeks; with the clock ticking, they tackle the kids' room first and turn it into a candy winter wonderland.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description: Guy Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.
